systems.system: projet de digitalisation des demandes de copies d'actes d'état civil
systems.country_label: digitalisation des demandes de copies d'actes d'état civil
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale (MATGLAC), Direction de l'administration territoriale et des frontières
systems.tiers: pilot phase launched 2025-12-19 in five pilot communes: Golfe 1, Agoè-Nyivé 1, Lacs 1, Avé 2 and Zio 2; national extension planned after evaluation

systems.system: matériel informatique remis aux communes pilotes
systems.owner: supplied by the ministère de l'Efficacité du service public et de la transformation digitale
systems.tiers: the five pilot communes, 2026-04-08: two computers, one printer, one UPS and two extension leads each, after the communes reported having no computers or printers to produce copies of acts

note: The pilot digitises requests for copies of acts, not the registration of events; the ministry states the pilot communes lacked computers and printers until 8 April 2026. Nothing on how a birth or death is recorded.
